llm.summary: This is an instruction-only skill for querying public Binance Web3 market ranking APIs, with no code, install hooks, credentials, persistence, or account-changing behavior shown.

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities match the stated crypto market ranking purpose, including token rankings, social hype, smart-money inflow, meme ranks, and wallet-address PnL leaderboards; address-level analytics can be sensitive even when public.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to GET/POST requests against disclosed web3.binance.com public API endpoints with example curl commands and response fields.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md; there are no executable scripts, package installs, hooks, or setup steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Outbound requests to Binance Web3 APIs are proportionate to market-data lookup, and the artifact does not request local files, secrets, wallet keys, environment variables, or account sessions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, local storage, privilege escalation, mutation authority, or credential handling is present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Use this for public crypto market research, but remember that wallet-address analytics can reveal trading behavior. Avoid entering private strategy, personal information, seed phrases, wallet credentials, or sensitive wallet context, and verify the publisher if official Binance affiliation matters to you.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The wallet-address PnL leaderboard concern is real as a privacy consideration, but the artifact clearly discloses address, PnL, balance, and trading metrics as part of its market research purpose and sources them through public API endpoints; this supports guidance rather than Review escalation.
